scope: Distinct desktop Ryzen, Ryzen PRO and Athlon SKUs
verificationPolicy: Each listed SKU has at least one AMD manufacturer product specification or official AMD launch/specification source in specificationSources. Missing or unpublished values remain blank or are qualified in specificationNotes.

It does not split cache into L2/L3 or state detailed socket, memory and PCIe specs; those fields remain unfilled pending a SKU-specific AMD page.
